name: Leader Carat
lines: “The Variants want one perfect needle, long enough to play the sun. I’m cutting it. I didn’t ask what for.”
“I’m asking now. Show me what you’re made of.”
win: “Not a flaw on you. The Electric Badge is yours. And the needle? It cracked in the cold. Funny, that.”
lose: “Rough cut. Polish it and come back.”
hint: Leader Carat’s Electric team is level 51–53. Ground Billies don’t care how much it hums.

seat.title: Electric Badge · 8 of 8
seat.rewardText: a Golden Parachute, 5 Gold Coins and 3 Platinum Coins
seat.unlockText: The Rimefrost Caves, east of Glimmershaft Town, are open. Beyond them, the inner sea.
